verdict.rationale: The docs say the Literature agent can run a deep literature review that synthesizes conflicting evidence across hundreds of papers. It also reasons over citation graphs and journal quality, and every finding traces back to the specific literature passage behind it, so contested claims can be checked against sources. This is a single marketing-level claim, though, with no description of how the output actually shows agreement versus disagreement. Missing for 10: a documented output format that explicitly maps which sources agree or disagree, examples of reports with conflicts flagged, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
